meta.title: Pricing — Clear prices from one company up
meta.description: Platform plans from one company to a hundred, fixed-price diagnostics, monthly monitoring and the founders programme. Prices in Mexican pesos, before VAT.

hero.title: Clear prices, from one company up.
hero.subtitle: No free plan. No per-seat pricing. You pay for the companies you analyze.

platform.title: Monthly plans
platform.extra: Each company beyond the included ones: {price} per month. The Individual plan does not take extra companies.
platform.fairUse: Fair use: up to {n} CFDI per company per month.

individual.name: Individual
individual.for: A founder with their own company

volumen.name: Volume
volumen.for: A company or account with an enormous number of CFDI

diagnostics.title: One-off, fixed price

esencial.name: Essential Diagnostic
esencial.asks: 24 months of CFDI — issued, received and payment complements
esencial.gives: Business Score, a six-section report and a 60-minute session

completo.name: Complete Diagnostic
completo.asks: Everything in the Essential, plus trial balance or ledger, inventory, and sales by customer and product
completo.gives: Everything in the Essential, plus operational and inventory analysis

asesores.name: Diagnostic for advisors
asesores.gives: A report under the advisor's brand, to resell

diagnostics.credit: If you take Monitoring within the next 30 days, we credit you 50% of the diagnostic.
diagnostics.monthsNote: Twenty-four months, because the Business Score compares the last 12 against the 12 before them. With less than 24 months, the trend indicators are reported as unavailable.

monitoring.name: Monthly Monitoring
monitoring.includes: A dashboard and a management report every month, plus a 60-minute quarterly review.

founders.title: The first {n} advisors pay half for {months} months.
founders.body: They also get a kick-off session. In exchange, they give us feedback every month, a testimonial, and their clients' authorization for the anonymous benchmark.

tax: Prices in Mexican pesos, before VAT.

closing.title: Not sure which one is yours?
closing.body: Tell us how many companies you serve and what you want to answer. We will say which plan fits, or whether none does.
